Tom (Sales): handoff for Kestrel Health pilot — 30d trial kicks off today. Asks: SAML SSO, VPC peering, rate-limit config for testing (target 500 rps bursts). Billing contact: finance@kestrelhealth.com.
Niya (CS): added to Gainsight; scheduling 30/45/55d touches. Need to capture API success %, p95 latency, and weekly active users.
Raj (Support): opening ticket; paste SAML metadata and peer CIDR and I will tag infra.
Tom (Sales): SAML sent via secure file, peer CIDR 10.34.0.0/16. No custom models; want hosted parity. Small set of system prompts to seed behavior.
provision-bot: Ticket CS-8123 created by Raj — "Kestrel pilot: SAML + VPC peering + rate-limit config". Assignees: @ike_eng, @niya_cs. ETA for peering validation: 48h.
Ike (Eng): Eng items: validate peering and run smoke tests; stage SAML on test IdP; configure rate-limit policy for test window and sanity-run quantized-v2. I’ll post smoke test cmds.
Raj (Support): added network checklist to CS-8123 and set priority high. Include traces for any >400ms requests.
Rowan (Success): I’ll prepare short week-1 survey and health scoring. Renewal risk: medium (depends on perf and infra friction).
Niya (CS): Owners recap: Ike — eng; Raj — support; Rowan — success; Tom — sales. Next steps: Ike confirm peering + smoke tests; Raj keep ticket updates; Tom schedule week-1 demo. Tag #eng-oncall if peering blocks.
